items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: The great horn player, Johnny Barrows, used to tell me in Montana he would go to school, very much like Mildred Bailey riding to school on a horse...

ctx.x: The great horn player, Johnny Barrows, used to tell me in Montana he would go to school, very much like Mildred Bailey riding to school on a horse, for ten or fifteen miles, and he would play the horn on horseback and probably why he became such a great horn player is because of that.
Here was a guy who lived all the way out in the boondocks, with no sort of enticement to do this, except a wish to do it. Where did it come from? Where did Mildred's come from?
